correctness.rationale: For cyclic indexed binary rings, labeled two-bit de Bruijn transitions of rule126 (output 0 exactly for uniform triples) give d_n(y)=tr(prod B_y). The labeled-one matrix splits into complement-even E=[[0,1],[1,1]] and complement-odd O=[[0,1],[-1,-1]], with Fibonacci and period-three traces. Each cyclic zero gap contributes simultaneous eigenvalues F_(a-1) and tau_a, proving the exact product formula for all outputs other than all-one (including adjacent zeros via F_-1=1). The all-one trace is Lucas L_n plus 2 if 3|n, else -1. Multi-zero output fibers are bounded by F_(n-3)+1, strictly below F_(n-2)+tau_(n-1) for n>=7; all-one exceeds that runner-up. Independently enumerated all indexed initial states and all outputs for n=1,...,12 and verified exact products, top, and one-zero equality for n>=7. All-length inequalities prove the unbounded statement.
